data.body:
Re-measured on current origin/main (6a4fd2fbb0): src/rebar/config.py is **799** lines, not 800 — Gerrit change 1919 (the CodeReviewConfig re-export that pushed it to 800) was abandoned and its ticket closed as rejected, so that line is not on main. Corrected the ticket's premise; the substance is unchanged (one line of headroom under the locked 800 cap, and already inside the gate's >=720 near-cap warning band), so the split still stands.

Seam implemented: the config **WRITE path** vs the read/resolve path. `_emit_toml` + `write_jira_config` are the only two symbols in config.py that write a file, and they form a closed call cluster (write_jira_config is _emit_toml's only caller). Extracted to `src/rebar/_config_writer.py`.

Result: config.py 799 -> 658 (142 lines headroom, out of the near-cap band); _config_writer.py 179 LOC.

Chose the write path over the resolution engine deliberately: nothing monkeypatches either moved symbol, whereas tests/unit/test_config_perf.py patches cfg._ordered_layers and cfg._discover_project_config — moving the resolver out from under those bindings would have changed behaviour.

Public surface proven unchanged by diffing dir(rebar.config) against origin/main: no rebar symbol removed, none added. Only delta is typing.Any (a stdlib leak used solely by the extracted emitter, zero consumers). _parse_toml became unused in config.py but is preserved as an explicit `as` re-export since rebar.config._parse_toml resolved before.

1916-lesson sweep: docs/env-vars.md DID drift — it records src/rebar/config.py:<line> for non-literal os.environ.get reads and is CI drift-gated. The 8-line re-export block shifted all five (295/308/312/319/572 -> 303/316/320/327/580). Regenerated in the same change; regeneration is now a fixed point. tests/golden/config_surface.json is key-keyed (no change needed); check_config_ownership.py and check_config_reads.py are basename-keyed and classify env-read/load_config/schema-field-read sites, none of which the write path performs — both gates pass with no new entry.

make lint 0, make typecheck 0, tests/unit/test_jira_onboard.py passes UNMODIFIED.
